articles.text: WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ jīntian hái yǒu kè ma?
COMRADE WÁNG: Do you have any more classes today?
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Méiyou kè le. Wǒ xiànzài niàn Fǎwén ne.
MR. COOK: I don't have any more classes. I'm studying French now.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐ niàn Fǎwén niànle duō jiǔ le?
COMRADE WÁNG: How long have you been studying French?
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ niànle yìnián le. Nǐ huì xiě Zhōngguo zì ma?
MR. COOK: I've been studying it for one year. Can you write Chinese characters?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Huì yìdiǎn. Qùnián wǒ hái bú huì xiě, xiànzài huì xiě yìdiǎn le.
COMRADE WÁNG: I can a little. Last year I couldn't write, but now I can write a little.
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Nǐ fùqin shi jūnrén ma?
MR. COOK: Is your father a military man?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Shì, tā shi hǎijūn jūnguān. Nǐ jīntian hǎo le méiyou?
COMRADE WÁNG: Yes, he's a naval officer. Are you better today?
KĒ XIĀNSHENG: Jīntian hǎo le. Xièxie.
MR. COOK: Today I'm better. Thank you.
